description: Material corporate events drawn from SEC filings, each with a plain-English description and a category (executive change, acquisition, funding, contract, product launch, expansion, regulatory and so on). Broader than search_sec_filings: use this to scan for what materially happened, and search_sec_filings when the user wants the filings themselves.

category.description: Event category. hiring = executive changes, acquisition = M&A, funding = financial events.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only results Fundz added on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (whole day, so a daily run may repeat that day). Overrides days. Use the date of your last run to get only what is new.

name: search_major_events
title: Search major events
